description: Estimate Ballistic’s platform fee for an amount leaving launch wallets. The fee is on what leaves the wallets, not on trading volume. Gives a figure for Solana and for a stable-coin amount; on BNB Chain and Robinhood Chain it gives the rate only. No account is read. Read-only arithmetic.

chain.description: Which chain the launch wallets are on. Required for native_out. No chain is assumed.

kind.description: native_out (default): the chain’s coin leaving launch wallets. stable_amount: a set stable-coin amount. primary_wallet: a withdrawal from the Primary wallet. unspent_funding: funding taken back with Recover.

volume.description: Optional. Buy and sell volume traded before withdrawing. It adds no platform fee.

withdrawn.description: The amount that leaves the launch wallets (after gas), not the amount that arrives.

name: estimate_fee
title: Estimate the platform fee
